paite: Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem a Moriah tang, apa David kiang a TOUPA kilakna, Jebus mi Ornan phualzang, David sehsa ah TOUPA' inn alam panta hi.
heading: Tempul Lam Patna / (1 Kum 6.1-38)

paite: Avaihawm akum lina kum, akha nihna, ani nih ni inn lam apan hi.
Pathian inn lamdan ding Solomon in angaihtuahdan hichibang ahi. Adunglam tong tehdan ngeina in tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi.
Amalam a inlim dunglam inn vailam tan mah tong sawmnih ahi a, asanlam za-le-sawmnih ahi a, asung dangka-eng chi kia in aluan hi.
Dantan lianzaw pen baang ah meilah sing athuap a, huai dangka-eng chi kia in aluan a, huai ah tum sing leh khainiang lim atuangsak hi.
Huchi in akilawmsak ding in bel suangmantam in azem a, dangka-eng bel Paravaim dangka-eng ahi.
Inn bel, kalhkangte, baangte, apialkhangte, kongkhakte dangka-eng in aluan a; baangte ah cherub limte atuangsak hi.
Mun Siangthoupen abawl a, adunglam in vailam tan mah, tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng chi ngen in aluan a, talent zaguk apha hi.
Akilhna gikdan dangka-eng shekel sawmnga ahi. Dantan tungnungte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Mun Siangthoupen ah cherub lim nih abawl a, huaite dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Cherub khate'n tong sawmnih akhak a, cherub khat kha tong nga ahi a, baang apha a, huan, akha langkhat leng tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
Huchi in cherub dang khat kha leng tong nga ahi a, baang a pha a; huan, akha langkhat tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
Cherubte'n tong sawmnih khak in akha uh azak ua, adingh ua, insung lam nga in adingh uhi.
Puanzak ding adumpuang, asandup, asan-au, khauzang ngatte in abawl a, huai ah cherub lim atuangsak hi.
Inn mailam ah tong sawmthum leh tong nga a sang khuam nih aphut a, huaite dawn tong nga tuaktuak ahi.
heading: Dal Khuam Nihte / (1 Kum 7.15-22)

paite: Huai ah khainiang abawl a, khuam dawn ah avial a; theibuhfai zakhat abawl a, khainiang ah akhai hi.
Tempul mailam ah khuam aphut a, khat taklam ah, khat veilam ah, taklam a pen Jakin achi a, veilam a pen Boaz achi hi.
